Prioritize ELIT and ASGR for momentum, avoid YELO/SLIS until volume confirms.

sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's 2025-2030 national energy plan mandates a 23% renewable mix, driving captive solar and biomass projects for industrial estates, directly lifting LAPD and ESSA order books.

US renewable names face rate-cut uncertainty and grid-connection bottlenecks, pushing institutional capital toward higher-yield Indonesian assets with clearer regulatory support and faster deployment
sectors.ai: Buy dips in Indonesian renewables leaders (LAPD, ESSA, KEEN) on policy tailwinds from the new government's 2030 green-energy targets and captive-industrial demand; US names lag, so rotate capital to ID pure-plays. Expect continued outperformance as project pipelines monetize and coal-to-solar transitions accelerate, with GGRP and POWR as tactical adds.

Accumulate PPGL and NELY on pullbacks, trim TRUK into strength, and hold SOCI for port congestion upside.
